title: The siege of North Heaven
summary: Mu Chen and Wen Busheng introduce themselves on the summit and take the Holy Spirit Baptism; Mu Chen's old injuries heal and he secures two perfect crystals, one saved for Luo Li. Ji Xuan's grandfather sums up Mu Chen as ruthless, sharp and formidable but says he has no idea what waits outside the mountain. At the academy the warding formation is broken, Mo You and Zhu Tian are pinned at the Holy Spiritual Pavilion, and Lord Beiming confronts Master Wuliang, mocking him over the Martial Ancestor; Wuliang asks which he can save, the academy or Tai Cang, now trapped in a Three Dragons Burning Heaven Cauldron. Elder Cao Xiu and the Heavenly Ranking students keep the North Heaven Gate open with formation flags so An Ran can lead the freshmen to shelter, while Fei Qingsong of the Supreme Cauldron Academy joins the attackers. The Yellow Dragon Sovereign comes to kill Mu Chen, and Liu Ying admits his father is working for the Dragon Demon Palace. Su Ling'er, No. 32 on the Heavenly Ranking, steps in to protect her sister Su Xuan, and Huo Feng and Gao Yang, the last man on the ranking, defend the formation flag as the students cry 'defend the glory of the academy to the death'. Xia Youran's father refuses to let the Jiuxia Chamber take sides.
